expectations.text: Baseline gives direct advice without invoking any specialized framework
expectations.evidence: Provides a time-vs-money calculation (72h/week, effective hourly rate), four clarifying questions, and a 'conditions to switch' framework. No mention of API calls, probability, Choice/Noul/Score, or env vars.
Discusses base vs stock composition, age/health considerations, recommends visiting the new company before deciding. Practical and concrete.
